note: Every number the village cards use for traffic, with its source. 'CITED' = copied from the named public source; 'DERIVED' = arithmetic on CITED numbers only; 'ASSUMED' = not from a source (or a source used outside what it measures). These pages were found by web search on 2026-11-18; the container could not open gb.go.kr, yd.go.kr, kosis.kr or codil.or.kr directly, so each CITED value is the text the search returned for that page, not a line-by-line reading. Re-check against the URL before operational use.

county_2024_11_30.source: 경상북도, 시ㆍ군별 주민등록 인구현황 (2024.11.30. 기준, 외국인 제외)

yeongdeok_eupmyeon_2025_12.caveat: Nine months after the March 2025 fire (the fire destroyed homes); the only per-읍·면 figures found. The nine add up to 19,389, the province's 2025-12-31 county total.

per_place_rule.rule: Households of a village = households of its 읍·면 (영덕군, yd.go.kr) or of its 시·군 (의성군, 청송군, 영양군; gb.go.kr) divided EQUALLY among the live 법정리 (and 법정동) of that 읍·면 or 시·군 in the 법정동코드 table (PublicDataReader 1.1.1.post2, SHA-256 pinned in data/sources.json). 안동시 is mostly urban 동, so its county average would overstate a rural 리: 안동시 villages take the 의성군 average per 법정리/동 instead (ASSUMED). Per-리 household counts were not found from any public source the session could reach.

care_facility.rule: A care facility (OSM social_facility / nursing_home) counts as 30 residents (ASSUMED; no public resident count found), none with a car of their own: all go on the pickup list. Staff cars are not counted.

gyeongbuk_vehicles_2024_12.source: 대구MBC, 자동차 누적 등록 대수 약 2,630만 대 (citing 국토교통부 자동차 등록 현황, end of 2024): "경북은 155만 2,434대가 등록돼"

vehicles_per_household.rule: 1,552,434 / 1,295,685. Province, not county (no county vehicle count found); dates differ by a year; all vehicle types (trucks, business vehicles included). Vehicles leaving a village = households x 1.198 (ASSUMED: every registered vehicle drives out, a conservative count; the no-car share is used only for the pickup list).

no_car_share.basis: KREI, 통계로 살펴보는 농어촌 주민의 삶의 질 (D374, 2013): 2010 census, 6,317 thousand of 17,342 thousand Korean households (36 %) own no car; 면 areas lowest ownership. National, 2010: applying it to 2025 villages is ASSUMED. A setting ([traffic] no_car_share).

context_not_used: 65+ share: 의성군 46.4 % (세계일보 2024-07-11, MOIS), 영덕군 43.5 % (영덕군 건강도시 프로파일, 2024)

two_lane.source: 국토교통부, 도로용량편람 (KHCM) 2013, p.170, 2차로도로 — as encoded in the KHCMinR package R/capa_2l.R ("Bi-directional value (3200 pcph). One-direction capacity is 1700 pcphpl. ... KHCM(2013), p.170"); the manual PDF (codil.or.kr) could not be opened

multilane_per_lane.source: KHCM 2013 p.144, 다차로도로 유형 I, via KHCMinR R/capa_ml.R

one_way_base.source: FHWA HPMS Field Manual, Appendix N (HCM 2000 based): "Change the base capacity from 3,200 pch to 1,600 pch" for one-way operation

narrow_road.rule: KHCM gives no capacity for 1-lane or village roads. Half the HPMS one-way base (1,600), for a single shared lane at village speeds: ASSUMED.

lanes.rule: The graph and basemap carry no lane counts. motorway / trunk: 2 lanes per direction at 2,200 pcphpl; primary, secondary, tertiary: two-lane road, 1,700 per direction; every other class (unclassified, residential, service, track, living_street, unmatched): narrow road 800. Passenger-car units = vehicles (ASSUMED: no heavy-vehicle factor).
